designationHistory.indexText: Established in August 1989 to protect bottomland hardwood forest and other forested wetlands of high value to waterfowl along the lower Roanoke River.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Roanoke River National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
FWS Roanoke River NWR brochure (govdocs copy): the refuge "was established in August 1989 to protect and enhance forested wetlands with high waterfowl value"

review.note: Draft sentence (1984, pocosin wetlands) belongs to Pocosin Lakes NWR. Roanoke River NWR dates to August 1989. Source is an FWS brochure; confirm with the CCP if possible.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The refuge was established in 1984 to protect the rare pocosin wetlands and their associated wildlife.
